articles.title: Visions of AI: the advent of world models
articles.content:
欢迎回归!

“AI愿景”是一个全新的栏目形式，我将尝试通过此栏目对AI或新兴科技初创企业进行简短的介绍。这个栏目的发布频率尚未确定，但有许多令人着迷的初创企业值得探讨和分享。

这个栏目设计为晚间轻松阅读，每晚8点东部时间发布。

在AI繁荣的背景下，新型AI初创企业的涌现和融资是可以预见的。尽管中国有所谓的世界机器人大会，但为了弥补大型语言模型（LLM）的局限性，另一种模型正在推进——难以捉摸的世界模型。

“世界模型是AI系统构建的一种内部心理模拟，描述了真实世界的物理、空间关系、几何和动态。”

随着我们建设物理基础设施以支持某些充满争议和不确定性的AI未来的计算需求，所有这些机器人和物联网系统都需要更好地理解其环境。

考虑到LLM的局限性，尚不清楚这些基于物理和模拟友好的世界模型需要多长时间才能加快训练我们那些突然变得人形的机器人项目。

虽然中国已经成为一家令人生畏的开源模型构建者，西方公司也在越来越多地基于其进行构建（例如Harvey在Moonshot AI的基础上构建模型），但新的世界模型竞赛正在升温。

作为一名加拿大人，我兴奋地听说Khosla Ventures和Radical Ventures正在领导一家加拿大初创企业的种子轮融资，这可能是加拿大有史以来最大的种子轮融资之一。这家公司名为Veeda，由三位前Nvidia员工创立，他们与多伦多大学有联系。

Veeda Innovation将专注于构建多模态世界模型。

具身智能和物理AI在2026年晚夏和早秋达到了狂热的程度。8月19日，我们得知著名计算机科学家Sanja Fidler正在与前Nvidia同事一起设立公司，并今天筹集了9000万美元的种子轮融资。Sanja是一位斯洛文尼亚-加拿大AI研究员，备受尊敬。

目前大约有半打非常好的世界模型初创企业，融资额非常可观。

“我们创立Veeda，是因为我们相信机器人将改变世界——改变我们移动人员和物品的方式，改变我们制造和建设的方式，以及我们在物理世界中的操作方式。”

《逻辑》杂志是最早报道这一消息的媒体之一。如果你是机器人爱好者，这将非常令人兴奋。随着Anthropic即将进行破纪录的IPO，有迹象表明它对该领域非常感兴趣，甚至可能收购“物理智能”公司。
articles.summary:
Welcome Back!

Visions of AI is a new feature format I’m experimenting with that will amount to a short profile on an AI or emerging tech startup. The cadence of this style of article is unknown as of yet, but there are a lot of fascinating startups I want to discuss and share about.

This is designed to be light evening reading to go out at a time-slot of 8 pm EST.

In an AI boom you would expect new kinds of AI startups to emerge and get funding. While China has what it calls the world robot conference, to complement the vast limitations of large language models (LLMs), another kind of model is being pushed forward - the elusive world model.

Subscribe now

A Starting definition of a World-Model

“A world model is an internal mental simulation constructed by an AI system that represents the physics, spatial relationships, geometry, and dynamics of the real world.”

As we build the physical infrastructure to power the compute for some much debated and uncertain AI-future, all these robots and IoT systems needs a better understanding of their environments.

Given the limitations of LLMs, it’s not clear how long or how useful these physics based and simulation friendly world models might take to be able to fast-track the training of our suddenly humanoid looking robotics projects.

While China has established itself a formidable open-weight model builder, that western companies are increasingly building upon (like Harvey building a model on a Moonshot AI base), the new race to world models is heating up.

As a Canadian it was exciting to hear that Khosla Ventures and Radical Ventures are leading the seed funding of what it turns out to be one of the largest seed financings ever raised by a Canadian startup. It’s called Veeda and is by three former Nvidia employees with ties to the University of Toronto.

Veeda Innovation will focus on building multi-modal world models.

View Mission

Embodied intelligence and physical AI are really hitting a feverish pitch in the late summer and early Fall of 2026. On August 19th we learned that renowned computer scientist Sanja Fidler, is setting up shop with former Nvidia colleagues and raising $90 million in a seed funding round today. Sanja is a Slovenian-Canadian AI researcher held in very high regard.

Read Introduction

There are now around a half dozen very good world model startups with extremely good funding.

Share

“We started Veeda because we believe robotics will reshape the world—changing how we move people and goods, how we manufacture and build, and how we operate in the physical world.”

The publication called The Logic was one of the first to break the story. If you are a robotics enthusiast this is very exciting. As Anthropic sets for a record breaking IPO there’s some indication it has serious interest in the field and perhaps even acquiring Physical Intelligence.
